raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

On ROCm, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with `--pipeline-parallel-size 2` and decoder SWA bounded replay (the default) crashes on the first prefill that builds a replay batch. PP=2 starts the second stage at layer 20, the last KV source and the replay cut. `_decoder_replay_supported` accepts that split (`start_layer == cut`), but `write_kv` does not handle a stage that has no residual yet. This PR adds the same stage-entry branch that `forward()` already has.

Depends on #63617. Without it, PP>1 on this model fails earlier, in `allocate_kv_cache` (#63615).

## Claims

- Fixes `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'shape'` (`write_kv` → `mhc_pre_delayed` → `_aiter_mhc_supported`) on the PP stage that starts at the replay cut. With the fix, PP=2 serves with replay on.
- Greedy logprobs with replay on match replay off at PP=2, with real weights, for a prompt longer than the 128-token window (which goes through `write_kv`) and for a short one.
- Adds a `vllm_runner` regression test to the MI355 DeepSeek-V4.1 step.

## Validation

All runs on 8× MI355X with `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-rocm100` (vLLM `0.32.1rc1.dev602+g5d35ce393`). #63617 and this PR's `model.py` change were applied in place; `model.py` on this branch's base (`b29caba14e`) is identical to the one in that image. The test was run with `MODEL` pointing at a local copy of `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`.

```
python3 -m pytest -v -s tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_amd_pp_replay.py
```

**Before the fix**: fails on the replay-on engine.

```
(Worker_PP1) File ".../vllm/models/deepseek_v41/amd/model.py", line 472, in write_kv
(Worker_PP1)   residual, post_mix, res_mix, x, _attn_pre = self.mhc_pre_delayed(
(Worker_PP1) File ".../vllm/model_executor/layers/mhc.py", line 85, in _aiter_mhc_supported
(Worker_PP1) AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'shape'
...
FAILED tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_amd_pp_replay.py::test_pp_stage_starting_at_replay_cut
```

**After the fix**:

```
tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_amd_pp_replay.py::test_pp_stage_starting_at_replay_cut PASSED
================== 1 passed, 15 warnings in 663.92s (0:11:03) ==================
```

**Serving** (4 independent PP=2 servers on one node, GPU pairs 0-1 … 6-7, replay on, official MI355X recipe without DSpark/monokernel):

- Needle-in-a-haystack, 7228-token prompts, needle at 10/50/90% depth: 12/12 correct.
- Prefill throughput, input tok/s per node:

| ISL | concurrency per server | PP=2, replay off | PP=2, replay on (this PR) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 8K | 4 | 145,846 | 191,752 |
| 8K | 16 | 194,129 | 203,085 |
| 16K | 4 | 177,910 | 200,326 |
| 16K | 16 | 196,711 | 202,601 |

`ruff check` / `ruff format --check` pass on the changed files.

## Details

**Root cause.** With PP, a stage hands off the settled stream: stage 0 ends with `mhc_post`, and `IntermediateTensors` carry `hidden_states` and `pre_mix` but no residual. `DeepseekV4DecoderLayer.forward` handles this entry (`residual is None` and a 3-D `x` mean the stream is already posted, so it runs a pre-only `mhc_pre_delayed`). `write_kv` is the replay-only path for the first replay layer and lacked that branch, so a stage whose first layer is the cut passed `residual=None` into the seam. `_run_replay_layers` has the same assumption in its `mhc_post` call for the cut's aux hidden state (DSpark). It now uses the posted input directly when there is no residual.

**Scope.**
- Only splits where a stage starts exactly at the cut reach this path. Other splits that keep every layer after the cut on one stage already worked, and splits that don't are rejected by `_decoder_replay_supported`.
- `vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/` has the same pattern in its `write_kv`. I did not change it because I can't test it.
- `mhc_pre_delayed` treats omitted and `None` post kwargs the same way, so passing `None` keeps the call shape unchanged.

**CI.** The test needs two CDNA4 GPUs and the real checkpoint (~476 GB). Dummy weights give near-uniform logits (top-5 logprobs all ≈ −ln|V|), so greedy tokens are noise and can't be compared. The test is added to `:amd: (MI355) DeepSeek-V4.1 Mono Decode Numerics` (mi355_4, `optional`), whose `source_file_dependencies` already cover `vllm/models/deepseek_v41/amd/`. That step only uses dummy weights today, so please confirm the MI355 agents have the checkpoint cached. If they don't, I'm happy to move the test to a step that does. It loads the model twice (~4.5 min each).

**Not a duplicate.** I found no open PR or issue touching `write_kv` or PP with replay on ROCm. #63106 / #63098 / #63321 work on NVIDIA DSv4.1 PP, and #63617 fixes the separate KV-planner failure this one depends on.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used for this PR. I reviewed every changed line and ran the tests above.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""DeepSeek-V4.1 decoder SWA bounded replay on ROCm under pipeline parallelism.
+
+With PP=2 the second stage starts at layer 20, the last KV source and the
+replay cut, so it enters replay with no layer of its own run first.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from .utils import check_logprobs_close
+
+MODEL = "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash"
+# Longer than the 128-token window, so prefill builds a replay batch.
+LONG_PROMPT = "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. " * 60
+SHORT_PROMPT = "The capital of France is"
+
+
+def _on_cdna4_with_two_gpus() -> bool:
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return False
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import get_cdna_version
+
+    return get_cdna_version() == 4 and current_platform.device_count() >= 2
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not _on_cdna4_with_two_gpus(), reason="needs two CDNA4 GPUs (ROCm V4.1 path)"
+)
+def test_pp_stage_starting_at_replay_cut(vllm_runner, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER", "1")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE", "1")
+    prompts = [LONG_PROMPT, SHORT_PROMPT]
+    outputs = {}
+    for replay in (False, True):
+        with vllm_runner(
+            MODEL,
+            pipeline_parallel_size=2,
+            language_model_only=True,
+            moe_backend="aiter",
+            engram_config={"cpu_offload": True},
+            attention_config={
+                "indexer_kv_dtype": "mxfp4",
+                "indexer_sparse_logits": True,
+            },
+            block_size=128,
+            max_model_len=2048,
+            max_num_batched_tokens=2048,
+            enforce_eager=True,
+            swa_bounded_replay=replay,
+        ) as llm:
+            outputs[replay] = llm.generate_greedy_logprobs(
+                prompts, max_tokens=8, num_logprobs=5
+            )
+
+    check_logprobs_close(
+        outputs_0_lst=outputs[False],
+        outputs_1_lst=outputs[True],
+        name_0="no_replay",
+        name_1="replay",
+    )
